statusDetail: Coverage complete for public home, mobile rendering, login entry, crawler/no-JavaScript behavior, security, network, performance and memory. Authenticated voter transactions, CAPTCHA completion, destructive/account actions and external linked systems were not covered because no test identity or authorization was provided.

paths.description: Public home/service directory representing the listing and primary navigation archetype; tested desktop, 360x800 mobile, preferences, keyboard focus, network, performance, security and memory.

Login route representing the primary account/form entry journey; tested mobile layout, field semantics, disabled initial state and raw HTML discoverability. Post-auth flows excluded because no authorized test identity/CAPTCHA solution was provided.
Raw HTML and JavaScript-disabled crawler comparison for home and login; also probed robots.txt and sitemap.xml.

findings.summary: Dark preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is byte-identical to the default capture; body stays white, computed color-scheme is normal, and the authored bundle contains no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and preference-driven surface tokens using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Blinking motion continues under reduced-motion
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched the user preference but still found the infinite 1-second blink animation running.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable the blinking label and other non-essential motion inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: High-contrast preference does not change the palette
findings.evidence: Under prefers-contrast: more, body and control colors remained unchanged; several controls still use low-contrast color pairs.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide higher-contrast tokens under prefers-contrast and preserve control boundaries in forced colors.

findings.summary: SPA route changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The downloaded authored CSS/JS contains no view-transition or startViewTransition usage; the tested home-to-login navigation is a same-document SPA route change.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance route changes with same-document View Transitions and retain an instant fallback.

findings.summary: The long page offers no scroll-state guidance
findings.evidence: The entry page is 5,164px tall on mobile, while the scroll capture and authored feature probe show no progress indicator, scroll-state query, or responsive sticky chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-position affordance or progress cue where it helps users orient in the long service list.

findings.summary: Page structure does not guide navigation for all users
findings.evidence: The rendered page has no h1-h3 headings and no main or nav landmark despite distinct Forms and Services sections; Lighthouse confirms no main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a main landmark and semantic section headings, and move focus to the route heading after SPA navigation.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport layout only
findings.evidence: The authored CSS/JS probe found no @container or container-type usage across a card-heavy reusable layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container queries for service and form cards that appear in different column widths, with existing viewport CSS as fallback.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible on primary buttons and some targets are undersized
findings.evidence: The focus probe found outline:none on Login, Sign-Up, and primary form buttons; Login is 33px tall and several controls are 21-36px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible ring and increase interactive target boxes to at least 44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: Loading performance misses the modern baseline
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 14.9s, FCP 7.9s, TTI 16.4s and performance 0.45; the independent trace measured LCP 4.03s. Both LCP runs exceed the 2.5s good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the critical path, prioritize the LCP content, and defer non-critical scripts and styles.

findings.summary: Script work delays interactivity
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 461ms TBT and a 335ms maximum potential input delay; the trace also recorded two long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Break up long tasks and defer optional framework/transliteration work until needed.

findings.summary: Render-blocking resources dominate the critical path
findings.evidence: The HAR captured 82 requests and 2.92MB transferred; Lighthouse estimates 6.92s savings from render-blocking resources, including fonts, styles and parser-inserted scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove parser-blocking scripts, trim font/style variants, preload only true critical assets, and give fonts a non-blocking display strategy.

findings.summary: The page ships large unused React, Angular, jQuery and CSS payloads
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 776KiB unused JavaScript and 370KiB unused CSS; the HAR shows 1.92MB of scripts and both Angular and React-like bundles on the entry route.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate framework/runtime layers, route-split optional features, and purge unused Bootstrap/font/transliteration CSS.

findings.summary: Accessible names, image alternatives and form labels are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags images without alt and visible-label/accessibility-name mismatches; the login captcha field has an empty aria-label and no associated label in the probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images concise alt text, decorative images alt="", preserve visible text in accessible names, and associate every input with a label.

findings.summary: Primary controls fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found numerous failures, including white on #28a745 at 3.13:1, white on #17a2b8 at 3.04:1, and white on #2bb9e9 at 2.27:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken control backgrounds or use dark text so normal text reaches at least 4.5:1 in every state.

findings.summary: Landmarks, headings and focus treatment are insufficient
findings.evidence: The DOM has no h1-h3 headings, no main/nav landmark, and primary buttons compute to outline:none when focused.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic headings and landmarks, preserve logical DOM order, and style :focus-visible clearly.

findings.summary: Small text and dense cards reduce reading comfort
findings.evidence: The focus probe and Lighthouse show several actionable labels rendered at 11-12px; the mobile screenshot shows dense card content and tightly packed controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise small actionable text to a comfortable responsive size and increase line-height and spacing within cards.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are below the recommended touch size
findings.evidence: The focus/target probe measured Login at 102x33 and many form actions at 36px high, although 360px reflow itself has no horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target hit areas while preserving the successful narrow-viewport reflow.

findings.summary: The page logs security, network and MIME errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a blocked inline script, invalid Google Fonts integrity, a 401 token-validation request, and a stylesheet served with text/html MIME.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the integrity hash and asset route/MIME type, avoid unauthenticated token validation, and remove blocked inline code.

findings.summary: Image dimensions and production asset hygiene are incomplete
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 13 images without both dimensions and 18 oversized images; Lighthouse also reports unminified CSS/JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width and height, serve assets close to display size, and ship minified production bundles.

findings.summary: BFCache, source maps and inspector hygiene need work
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports BFCache blocked by no-store, missing source maps for large first-party bundles, and CSP inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Use no-store only where sensitive state requires it, publish production source maps securely, and clear DevTools inspector issues.

findings.summary: Entry metadata is generic and duplicated
findings.evidence: Both title and meta description are exactly “Citizen Service Portal”; the login title changes but its raw HTML still exposes the entry title.
findings.suggestedFix: Write unique, descriptive titles and descriptions for the portal and each public route.

findings.summary: Important links and crawler directives are not crawlable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found anchors without href and generic “Read more” text; /robots.txt returns the SPA HTML rather than valid robots directives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for navigable services, descriptive link text, and serve a valid robots.txt.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap/indexing signals are missing
findings.evidence: The DOM has no canonical link, and /sitemap.xml responds 200 with the app shell rather than XML.
findings.suggestedFix: Add route-appropriate canonical links and serve a real XML sitemap consistent with robots policy.

findings.summary: The public civic portal has no structured or social metadata
findings.evidence: The page probe found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph properties despite visible Election Commission organization/service content.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/GovernmentService JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Authentication lacks a phishing-resistant option and misuses autocomplete
findings.evidence: The login route offers OTP after identifier plus CAPTCHA but no passkey/WebAuthn capability; the identifier field uses one-time-code and CAPTCHA uses new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys alongside OTP where feasible and use accurate autocomplete tokens (for example username/email rather than one-time-code on the identifier).

findings.summary: Permissions Policy is absent and CSP retains unsafe-inline for styles
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found strong HSTS, XFO, nosniff and referrer policy, but no Permissions-Policy; style-src allows unsafe-inline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and migrate inline styles toward nonce/hash or stylesheet-based rules where practical.

findings.summary: Core civic content disappears without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 3% raw/rendered content coverage on home and 9% on login; both ship an empty #root and the crawler screenshot only says JavaScript is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the core service directory and login instructions/forms, then hydrate optional enhancements.

findings.summary: The app-like portal has no installable/offline surface
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no web app manifest and the login route was not controlled by a service worker.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a manifest and a narrowly scoped service worker that provides an offline information/retry page without caching sensitive voter data.

findings.summary: Missing infrastructure routes return misleading success shells
findings.evidence: Requests for /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both return HTTP 200 with the generic SPA HTML, showing that unknown infrastructure routes are not represented with correct content/status.
findings.suggestedFix: Configure explicit static robots/sitemap responses and a real 404/error route with recovery actions for unknown paths and failed APIs.

findings.summary: Multilingual UI is not fully language- or direction-ready
findings.evidence: The portal offers English and Hindi, but the document only declares lang=en, has no dir attribute, and the authored bundle probe found no logical CSS properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Update html lang for the selected language, set dir where needed, and replace physical spacing/position properties with logical equivalents.

findings.summary: Login autocomplete tokens obstruct input assistance
findings.evidence: The login identifier is marked autocomplete=one-time-code while CAPTCHA is new-password, neither matching the field purpose.
findings.suggestedFix: Use username or email for the identifier as appropriate and disable autocomplete on CAPTCHA without pretending it is a new password.

findings.summary: Images are frequently oversized or lack efficient loading
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 18 oversized images, 49 below-fold images without lazy loading, 13 missing dimensions and 8 legacy-format assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve appropriately sized modern variants, lazy-load below-fold content, and set intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Large unused code and background validation waste resources
findings.evidence: The page transfers 2.92MB, including 1.92MB scripts; Lighthouse estimates 776KiB unused JS, and an unauthenticated token-validation request returns 401 on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not validate absent sessions, remove duplicate runtimes, and conditionally load transliteration and route-specific code.

findings.summary: Font and third-party weight is disproportionate to the simple portal UI
findings.evidence: The HAR attributes 314.8KB to third parties and 308KB to fonts; one early-access font stylesheet alone transfers 272.7KB while Lighthouse says it is 100% unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Self-host only required font subsets, remove the unused early-access stylesheet, and reduce third-party requests.
